falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows and multi-week consolidation; blowoff score of 40 suggests vulnerability, not breakout strength

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX contradicts the bottom formation thesis which requires elevated or expanding volatility; this would signal complacency inconsistent with August 2024-style capitulation bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-quality bid in bonds at that level would indicate recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom, breaking the macro regime similarity to August 2024 when yields stabilized in a higher range

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
